name: habits
description: Agentic habits in three tiers: stated rules placed where their trigger fires, gates that make the ones that must not fail deterministic, and a read-only judge that scores adherence from evidence. Ships a working Stop hook, 20 starter habits, and 12 named anti-habits.

permissions.filesystem: Reads this repository. Writes only to a user's instruction files, and only after showing the exact content and receiving an explicit yes.
permissions.settings: Never edits settings.json without showing the exact block and receiving an explicit yes. The Stop gate is proposed, never silently installed.
permissions.network: None. No script here makes a network call.
permissions.credentials: Never read, never stored, never written to a habit file or a case.
